cleaned_candidate_pool.definition: primary labeled health/sick/tb rows after confirmed external exact overlaps and bundled external rows are excluded; no split is frozen

near_duplicate_method: shared 32-bit dHash band candidate generation, Hamming distance <= 8; candidates require review and are not auto-excluded
pending_review: TBX11K test ground truth is not released; test rows retain canonical_label=None.

The release path/list files expose a single tb/ folder; exact Active/Latent/Active+Latent/Uncertain subtype for those 800 labeled trainval rows is not recoverable from the archive and is not inferred.
No trustworthy patient/group identifiers are present in the release.
Perceptual candidates are flags for review, not automatic exclusions.
perceptual_overlap_review: All cross-dataset dHash candidates are preserved in tbx11k_overlap_review.csv with review_status=pending_review and exclusion_applied=no; the 662 Shenzhen and 138 Montgomery candidates are concentrated in bundled extra/test paths.
